name: ticks
useFor: Use for any share or count drawn as a measure: progress, a fit score, a loading key's walk. Set `pitch` (6px for bars, 4px for the text button's underline), and `value` (0 to 1) or `filled` (a number of lines, so no tick is half lit). `on` and `off` take brand color variables: Forest over Stone, or Mist for empty.
source: Figma "UI · Progress" (442:213) and the Buttons board (442:3) loading state
title: Ticks
description: A row of 1px vertical lines at a fixed pitch: the system's measuring language for progress, loading keys and scores.
